context:
Extract helper methods as private (prefixed _) on the same class or as module-level
functions if they don't use self. Keep render() as the public entry point that
orchestrates helpers in order.

Reference existing decomposed charts: ascii/line_chart.py is well-structured -
note how it organizes helpers as private methods. Follow that pattern.

Test approach: capture render() output before and after and compare with assertEqual.
description:
7 ASCII chart render() functions accumulate complexity by doing layout calculation,
data normalization, header rendering, bar/cell rendering, and legend rendering all in
one method. Each concern is independent and can be a private helper method. This
reduces per-function complexity from 15-20 to well below the warn threshold without
changing behavior.

Target functions:
  benchbox/core/visualization/ascii/heatmap.py:render               (20)
  benchbox/core/visualization/ascii/histogram.py:_render_simple_chunk (20)
  benchbox/core/visualization/ascii/histogram.py:_render_grouped_chunk (20)
  benchbox/core/visualization/ascii/diverging_bar.py:render          (17)
  benchbox/core/visualization/ascii/summary_box.py:render            (17)
  benchbox/core/visualization/ascii/sparkline_table.py:render        (15)
  benchbox/cli/commands/visualize.py:_render_ascii_charts            (16)

Note: Several render() functions are already approved as required-complexity ignores
(line_chart, box_plot, scatter_plot, bar_chart, rank_table, cdf_chart). The functions
listed above are NOT in that list - their complexity is reducible.

anti_patterns.dont: create a base class or mixin for shared helpers
extract so many small helpers that reading render() requires jumping between 10 methods
optimize the rendering logic while refactoring

preserves.behavior: All chart output must be pixel-for-pixel identical - test with known data fixtures
Color codes and ANSI escape sequences must be identical
Column width calculations must produce the same values
render() method signatures unchanged (callers pass same arguments)

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/ -k 'ascii or visual or chart or render' -q

verifications.expected: No WARN entries for the 7 target functions
